comment: The notes block an annotated image adds to the prompt (crates/ui annotate.rs `prompt_block`). Boxes are numbered like their pins, in drawing order, with their pixel box in the flattened file as x,y,w,h rounded to whole pixels; a box with no note says (no note). Text marks follow under 'Text on the image:' and empty ones are left out. Notes are trimmed and folded to one line, and double quotes in text marks become single quotes. The desktop checks it in harness-ui (`the_prompt_format_matches_the_parity_vectors`); a phone port of annotate should run the same cases.

cases.name: shot-annotated.png
cases.prompt:
Annotations on shot-annotated.png (boxes are x,y,w,h in image pixels):
1. [box 120,80,300,140] tighten this

cases.case: fractions round, empty notes say so, notes fold to one line
cases.name: ui-annotated.png
cases.prompt:
Annotations on ui-annotated.png (boxes are x,y,w,h in image pixels):
1. [box 10,11,100,50] (no note)
2. [box 0,0,8,8] two lines

cases.case: text marks after boxes, quotes softened
cases.name: a-annotated.png
cases.prompt:
Annotations on a-annotated.png (boxes are x,y,w,h in image pixels):
1. [box 40,400,200,60] move up
Text on the image:
- [text 500,30] "say 'hi'"
